title: Quelccaya Glacier Tour Full Day
short_description: Explore the largest tropical glacier in the world on a breathtaking high-mountain expedition connecting high-Andean wetlands, glacial lakes, and Sibinacocha Lake.
long_description:
The Quelccaya Glacier Tour Full Day is one of the most impressive high-mountain experiences you can enjoy in Cusco. This excursion takes you to one of the most important tropical glaciers on the planet, surrounded by high-Andean landscapes, glacial lakes, and unique ecosystems that showcase the natural beauty of the Peruvian mountain range.

During the trip, we will pass through the community of Phinaya, vast peatlands, lakes of glacial origin, and finally reach the impressive ice fields of Quelccaya. It is an ideal experience for lovers of nature, photography, and high-altitude mountain adventure.
price_note: Includes tourist transportation, breakfast and lunch in Phinaya, bilingual professional guide, entrance fees, oxygen kit, first aid kit, and trekking poles.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco – Phinaya – Quelccaya Glacier – Sibinacocha Lake – Cusco
days.lugar: Cusco → Phinaya → Quelccaya Glacier → Sibinacocha → Cusco
days.text:
The tour begins with hotel pick-up at approximately 03:00 a.m. to set off on a journey of about 6 hours toward the community of Phinaya, crossing stunning Andean landscapes.

Upon arrival in Phinaya, we will enjoy breakfast at a local restaurant. Afterward, we will continue by transport for approximately 30 minutes to the nearest parking area to Quelccaya Glacier, considered the largest tropical glacier in the world.

From this point, we will begin a 30 to 45-minute hike, ascending to an altitude of approximately 5,100 to 5,200 m.a.s.l. Along the path, we can admire crystal-clear lagoons, streams, Andean wildlife such as vicuñas, and the majestic peaks of the Vilcanota range. Upon reaching the glacier, your guide will share insights about the area, and you will have around 1 hour to enjoy the scenery, take photos, and explore.

After the visit, we will walk back to our transport to return to the community of Phinaya for a local lunch. Next, we will start the journey back to Cusco, stopping at Sibinacocha Lake—one of the largest and most beautiful lakes in the high Andes—for photos. Finally, we will continue our return to Cusco, completing an unforgettable experience.

faq.pregunta: How difficult is the hike at Quelccaya Glacier?
faq.respuesta: The hike is relatively short (30 to 45 minutes each way), making the physical difficulty moderate. However, the main challenge is the high altitude (over 5,000 m.a.s.l.), so proper acclimatization in Cusco beforehand is essential.
Pick-up starts at 03:00 a.m. from your hotel located in Cusco's Historic Center to make the most of the day.

faq.pregunta: Is emergency oxygen provided on the tour?
faq.respuesta: Yes, our transport carries an oxygen cylinder and a first aid kit to assist travelers experiencing altitude symptoms.

faq.pregunta: What clothing should I wear for this expedition?
faq.respuesta: Since this is a high-mountain glacier environment, temperatures are usually very low. Dressing in layers is recommended: thermal base layer, windproof/waterproof jacket, gloves, beanie, scarf, and sturdy hiking shoes with good traction.
